item.text: [{"task_id":"e7b06bea","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    origin = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    shift = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    step = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    height, width = grid.shape","    if origin < 0 or origin >= width or origin >= height or step <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    block = int(np.count_nonzero(grid[:, origin] == marker))","    columns = []","    for column in range(width):","        color = int(grid[origin, column])","        if color != background and color != marker:","            columns.append(column)","    if block <= 0 or len(columns) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    destination = columns[origin] + shift","    if destination < 0 or destination >= width:","        return grid.copy()","    palette = [int(grid[origin, column]) for column in columns]","    output = grid.copy()","    for column in columns:","        output[:, column] = background","    for row in range(height):","        index = ((row // block) * step) % len(palette)","        output[row, destination] = palette[index]","    return output"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[0,5,0,-1,1]},"rationale":"The gray marker's height sets the run length.
